title: Network of Theseus (like the ship)
abstract: arXiv:2512.04198v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: A standard assumption in deep learning is that the inductive bias introduced by a neural network architecture must persist from training through inference. The architecture you train with is the architecture you deploy. This assumption constrains the community from selecting architectures that may have desirable efficiency or design properties due to difficulties with optimization. We challenge this assumption with the Network of Theseus (NoT), a method for progressively converting a trained, or even untrained, guide network architecture part-by-part into an entirely different target network architecture while preserving the performance of the guide network. At each stage, components in the guide network architecture are incrementally replaced with the target architecture modules and aligned via representational similarity metrics. translated_title: 忒修斯之网络（如同那艘船）
translated_abstract: 深度学习中的一个标准假设是：神经网络架构所引入的归纳偏置必须从训练阶段一直延续到推理阶段，即你用什么架构训练，就用什么架构部署。这一假设使得研究者无法选择那些可能具有理想效率或设计特性、但存在优化困难的架构。我们提出“忒修斯之网络”来挑战这一假设，该方法能够将一个已训练（甚至未训练）的引导网络架构逐部分地渐进转换为完全不同的目标网络架构，同时保持引导网络的性能。在每个阶段，引导网络架构中的组件被逐步替换为目标架构的模块，并通过表征相似性度量进行对齐。即使在发生重大架构变化的情况下，该过程仍能保留引导网络的大部分功能……
tldr: 提出忒修斯之网络方法，通过逐步替换组件并用表征相似性度量对齐，在保持性能的前提下将训练好的网络架构渐进转换为完全不同的目标架构，打破了“训练架构即部署架构”的传统假设。
en_tdlr: Network of Theseus (NoT) progressively replaces components of a trained network with modules of a completely different target architecture, aligned via representational similarity metrics, preserving the guide network's performance and challenging the assumption that the training architecture must be the deployment architecture.
